description: Regression: server text without a trailing newline is visible in the prompt overlay, but when the server then closed the connection the overlay was discarded and the text never reached scrollback, so farewell messages and a final prompt vanished at disconnect.

scenarios.name: final unterminated server text survives a server close

steps.note: "Farewell, adventurer." with no newline, as the last bytes before close
the user can see it before the close
a connection change commits the visible partial line
